**RA Progress Statement — Seoul–Daegu Honorific Shift Corpus**  
Reporting date: Monday, November 9, 2026

I am submitting this statement for the Winter 2027 funding review. I am the only RA on the Seoul–Daegu Honorific Shift Corpus doing Korean annotation.

As of November 9, 2026, my annotation total is 4,200 utterances toward the fall-term target of 6,000. This total includes 2,300 existing utterances that I recoded under the revised speech-level scheme Prof. Hollander requested in August—work that was not in the original timeline—and approximately 1,900 new annotations completed since October 15. Since October 15 I have averaged more than 500 utterances per week, compared with the planned 350. At that pace, I expect to reach 6,000 by the end of January 2027.

The fall timeline was affected by the IRB amendment required to add the 14 new Daegu recordings. I sent the amendment to Prof. Hollander for signature on September 3, 2026. I sent reminders on September 12, September 24, and October 6, 2026, and I have retained those emails. The amendment was signed on October 15, 2026. I could not annotate the new recordings until it was signed.

At the November 6, 2026 lab meeting, the annotation was described as “six weeks behind” without this context. The delay in beginning the new recordings corresponds to the period between September 3 and October 15.

For the review record, I ask that the note either reflect that the annotation delay followed the September 3–October 15 signature delay on the IRB amendment, or omit the “six weeks behind” comment. Recorded without the cause, the comment suggests slow or careless work, which the timeline above does not support.
